verdict.rationale: No priority is given among proximity robustness, price, rating, parking type, pool/hot-tub amenities, or restaurant access. All rates and drive times are explicitly viable, and each option presents a reasonable two-hotel tradeoff: B emphasizes the closest pair, C emphasizes lower cost and surface parking, D balances a close option with the highest-rated/full-amenity option, and A maximizes rate/amenity contrast at the cost of less predictable drives. Therefore no single shortlist is clearly dominant.
